summary: Nirvati provides a web-based interface intended to simplify the deployment of common self-hosted applications. It abstracts standard container management tasks into a single dashboard for administrators running their own infrastructure.
goodFor: It suits home lab operators who want a graphical control panel to quickly instantiate popular services without manually writing configuration files.
watchOut: The project currently lacks tagged releases, indicating early-stage maturity and potential instability for production environments.
deployNotes: Because the backend is built with Rust and targets Kubernetes, you will typically need an existing cluster setup along with persistent volume provisioning for application data.
